Hi all —

Thanks for agreeing to a joint walkthrough slot so we can demo the latest inference routing and fallbacks for your teams. To make scheduling straightforward I attached a short calendar_matrix.csv with two evening windows (US PT) and one late-morning option that covers APAC-friendly overlap.

Quick ask: can you each reply with the single row you prefer (A / B / C) and whether you want a 45 or 60 minute session. We want to pin hosts now so Marcus and I can prep the environment + customer-specific prompts.

Attachments: calendar_matrix.csv (two time windows + host pairing suggestions)

Thanks,

- Duration: 60 minutes
- Hosts: Marcus (runtime + perf) and Laura (security/private deploys). Neha will monitor Q&A.
- Deliverables: I will attach mutual_action_plan_v3.pdf and a one-page ports/KMS slide to the calendar invite. Marcus, please add the shared meeting note doc link (and I will enable recording).

I will send the calendar invite and attach the two documents now. If anyone needs a different dial-in (Zoom vs Google Meet) let me know; defaulting to Google Meet.

Thanks — see you Wednesday.
